title.buildingExistingPr: Applying changes to an existing PR…

prCard.buildingHint: You'll be asked to create the PR when it settles.
prCard.buildingExistingPrHint: Specrails is working on the existing PR branch and will push the review changes back to that PR.
prCard.checkoutTooltip: Check out {{branch}} in the main project folder
prCard.checkoutFailed: Could not check out the PR branch
prCard.discardedNote: Discarded — specs returned to the backlog
prCard.supersededNote: A newer implementation run replaced this card.
prCard.noChangesExisting: No new changes were needed; the existing PR is unchanged.
prCard.noChangesNote: No code changes were needed. Mark the specs done or return them to the backlog to refine.
prCard.deliveryBlockedNote: Implementation succeeded, but delivery is blocked. Review the stage detail and run logs before discarding the local result.
prCard.retryPushNote: Implementation succeeded and the changes are safe locally. Retry only the push.
prCard.implementationFailedNote: The implementation run failed before there was anything deliverable. Open the run log to inspect the failure, then discard this card before relaunching.

degraded.pushed: The branch was pushed but the PR could not be created — retry to finish.
degraded.localOnly: The changes were assembled locally but not pushed — retry to publish the PR.

prCard.mergeLocalTooltip: Merge the delivered branches into {{base}} in your local checkout (no GitHub needed)
prCard.mergeLocalBlockedDirty: Cannot integrate: your working tree on {{base}} has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them, then retry.
prCard.mergeLocalBlockedBranch: Cannot integrate: your checkout is on {{current}}, not {{base}}. Check out {{base}}, then retry.

confirm.mergeLocalBody: The delivered branches will be merged into {{base}} in your local checkout. Your checkout must be on {{base}} with a clean working tree.
confirm.freshDiscardBody: The launch's branches and worktrees will be removed and its specs will return to the backlog. This cannot be undone.
confirm.implementationFailedDiscardBody: The card will be cleared and its specs will return to the backlog. Local work and branches will be kept for inspection. Only resources proven safe to clean up may be removed.
confirm.dismissBody: Only this follow-up card and its owned worktree will be cleared. The existing PR, its branch, and review state will remain unchanged.
confirm.discardLocalBody: The recoverable local iteration will be removed. Any existing PR and its branch will remain unchanged. This cannot be undone.
confirm.noChangesDoneBody: The implementation confirmed that no code changes are needed. The specs will move to Done and the no-change worktree will be cleaned up.
confirm.refineBody: The no-change result will be closed and the specs will return to the backlog so you can refine them. The run logs remain available.
